core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Feroza corresponds to the Persian form فيروزة (Persian فیروزه (fīrūza)). Its core sense is turquoise. Feroza is the feminine/derived form of Persian فیروز (Fīrūz) 'victorious', specifically فیروزه (Fīrūza), the word for the gemstone turquoise. The source labelled it 'Arabic' and glossed it 'gentle, delicate, beautiful'; the lexical sense is 'turquoise' (and, from the base word, 'victorious').
